bullets.title: DELL: Massive Beat/Raise — FY27 Guide to $192B Rev (+70%), $25.50 EPS (+150%)
bullets.body: Q2 revenue $47.0B (+58% y/y) crushed guidance of $44-45B; EPS $7.04 vs $4.70-$4.90 guidance. AI server revenue $16.4B (+100% y/y) with $60.9B in AI orders and $95B backlog across 6,500+ customers. FY27 AI server revenue guide raised to $74B (3x y/y); Citi raises PT to $600 (Buy), MS sees $96B FY27 ISG revenue and $499 PT, JPM notes 42% FY27 EPS raise to $25.50 with OpEx at 8% (42-year low); bears cite pull-forward risk with AI server growth lapping 130%+.

bullets.title: MDB: Beat/Raise on Atlas Strength, But AI Pull-Through Still Unproven — Stock -13.8%
bullets.body: Q2 revenue $771.8M (+30% y/y) beat consensus $735M; Atlas grew 29% y/y for fifth consecutive quarter, adding record ~$127M YoY revenue with NRR improving to 122%. FY27 revenue guide raised to $2.99-3.03B (~21-23% growth). Bulls (Citi PT $565, Mizuho PT $460) cite record customer adds and improving AI signals via Voyage/Vector Search; UBS stays Neutral, cuts PT to $410 (7.5x CY28E EV/S), arguing AI pull-through not yet material for JSON-based operational databases vs. Snowflake/Palantir.

bullets.title: PANW F4Q26: Strong Beat — NGS ARR +63%, Mythos Driving Platformization; Wolfe PT $410
bullets.body: F4Q26 revenue grew 34% y/y, 1.7% ahead of consensus; NGS ARR grew 63% y/y with $970M NNARR ($170M ahead of guidance). Record 220 net new platformizations (+44% y/y) driven by Mythos platform; Prisma AIRS ARR exceeded $120M, XSIAM ARR +70% y/y. Wolfe raises PT from $320 to $410 (Outperform); stock up 97% YTD vs IGV +1%, now trading 52x EV/CY27E FCF at 23% premium to Scaled Leaders peer group.

bullets.title: NVDA: In Advanced Talks to Acquire Hugging Face for ~$12.9B + $1B Retention Package
bullets.body: Bloomberg reports deal could close this week at ~$12.9B purchase price plus $1B staff retention package. Microsoft had also been in talks with Hugging Face but those discussions have ended. Hugging Face had previously rejected NVDA's $500M investment offer at a $7B valuation in January 2025.

bullets.title: AVGO: PT Cut $485→$470 on F27 AI Revenue Trim (~$5B) to ~$130B; Buy Maintained
bullets.body: UBS trimmed AVGO F2027 AI revenue by ~$5B to ~$130B due to aggressive TPU unit shipment estimates. Anthropic TPU shipments estimated at $2.5B in FQ3, ramping to $3.3B in FQ4; GCP-related AI revenues expected to increase ~$2B Q/Q in FQ3 followed by ~$1.5B step-up in FQ4. OpenAI contributes ~$1.25B/$12B of revenue in C2026/C2027.

bullets.title: CRWD: Fal.Con'26 Pre-Game — AI-Native SafeMind and Potential FY31E ARR Acceleration to $10B
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy ahead of 10K+ attendee Falcon'26 event focused on 'Autonomously Securing AI'; management telegraphing potential FY31E ARR target of $10B (implying 11-13% CAGR from FY27 vs. current 26% guidance). SafeMind productization anchored on purpose-built security models for agentic defense; analyst notes M&A speculation elevated given CRWD's size and share currency. Near-term/medium-term ARR guidance updates unlikely for FY28E given post-outage model normalization.

bullets.title: TSLA: Cybercab Launch 9/3 — Unsupervised Fleet Grew ~200% to 156 Units by End-August
bullets.body: MS flags positive bias for TSLA if unsupervised robotaxi rollout is announced at 9/3 Cybercab launch; 45 Cybercabs registered with TX DMV. Unsupervised Tesla robotaxi fleet grew ~200% from Q2 (57 units) to end-August (156 units).

bullets.title: AAPL: Foldable iPhone Could Contribute ~$14B in Dec Quarter; Pro Models Up $200+ on NAND/DRAM Costs
bullets.body: MS estimates Apple's first foldable iPhone could contribute ~$14B of December quarter revenue with 7-8M builds in C2H26. iPhone 18 Pro moving to TSMC 2nm process; Pro models expected to rise $200+ y/y due to rising NAND/DRAM costs.

bullets.title: CRDO: Beat but Disappoints — Flat $600M Optical Guide vs. Buyside ~$1B Expectation
bullets.body: CRDO beat guidance and street consensus but fell short of higher buyside expectations; failed to raise the $600M optical guide despite buyside expectations around $1B. JPM flags growth deceleration and client concentration risks as key concerns post-print.

bullets.title: DKNG: Wolfe Initiates Outperform, $40 PT — Top Pick in New Gaming & Lodging Coverage
bullets.body: Wolfe's Peter Supino launches coverage with Market Overweight on online gaming; DKNG is top pick (OP, $40 PT) citing top execution and scale in US sports betting with prediction market cost/benefits viewed as underappreciated. Land-based gaming trends mixed on affordability pressures; iGaming legalization progresses slowly but represents long-term upside for online platforms.

bullets.title: ROTH Enterprise AI Survey: Tracking Hyperscaler Budget Allocation for GOOGL, AMZN, META
bullets.body: Roth Capital fielding enterprise AI budget allocation survey targeting senior IT decision makers at large/medium U.S. enterprises. Survey measures AI ROI, platform preferences across hyperscalers, and adoption of ML, NLP, RPA, predictive analytics, and computer vision — results pending.

bullets.title: HPE/NTAP: UBS Expects Beat/Raise Quarters on Resilient Enterprise Demand
bullets.body: UBS notes HPE expects a beat/raise quarter with solid broad-based demand and server ASPs up 50-100% with no meaningful demand destruction. NTAP distributors/resellers indicate resilient July-quarter demand; price increases have not caused meaningful demand destruction.
